name: Zed AI
tagline: Zed is a high-performance code editor built in Rust that includes native AI features: inline code generation, an assistant panel for chatting with LLMs, and real-time collaboration. Its tight integration between editing speed and AI makes it a favourite among developers who want both performance and intelligence.
